paragraphs: The XE 300 Sport was a special-edition variant of the X760-generation XE, produced from around 2018 to 2019. It uses the AJ126 — a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine, shared with other performance-oriented Jaguar models of the era. The 300 Sport sat above the standard V6 S in the XE range, offering a more focused specification with distinct styling and chassis upgrades. The AJ126 is a direct-injection, supercharged unit that delivers strong, linear power — characteristic of Jaguar's supercharged V6 family. The XE 300 Sport is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar XE 300 Sport Engine Compatibility The XE 300 Sport uses the AJ126 supercharged V6, fitted exclusively to the X760 generation. Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. For most XE 300 Sport owners, yes. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XE 300 Sport from 2023 to present. The AJ126 (3.0L V6 supercharged) features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ126 (3.0L V6 supercharged) V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ126 (3.0L V6 supercharged) rebuild.
